page: Amazon Web Services r8idb.metal-96xl is a bare-metal memory-optimized instance featuring 192 physical cores and 384 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by Intel processors operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz with two threads per core, this bare-metal configuration eliminates hypervisor virtualization overhead to provide direct access to the underlying hardware for latency-sensitive applications.

The instance delivers high capacity across memory, storage, and interconnect subsystems. It is configured with 3072 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Local storage consists of 22,800 GB of bundled NVMe SSD capacity, providing direct instance storage for high-IOPS operations. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 400 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

By consolidating significant core density, high-speed interconnects, and local NVMe storage without discrete GPU accelerators, the resource profile emphasizes high memory capacity and physical I/O efficiency over graphics computing. This hardware profile is appropriate for enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale transactional processing, real-time analytics pipelines, and distributed memory-resident caching architectures.

This profile is engineered for memory-heavy and I/O-intensive workloads, including enterprise in-memory databases, real-time data streaming engines, distributed memory caches, and large-scale transactional platforms.
